subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless `web_search` provider despite the previous merged Firecrawl boundary keeping search credentialed and Firecrawl docs still declaring bearer auth?
rationale: The code path is mechanically reviewable, but routing user search queries to a hosted no-auth tier and adding a public provider id are product, privacy, and support decisions that prior maintainer discussion left for explicit sponsorship.

options.title: Pause keyless search
options.body: Keep Firecrawl search credentialed for now and pause or close this provider addition until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the public provider id and support boundary.

options.title: Accept the opt-in provider
options.body: Approve the security/product boundary, then require conflict resolution, exact-head checks, and retained credential-isolation coverage before merge.

options.title: Narrow to credentialed options
options.body: Drop `firecrawl-free` and keep only the `/v2/search` parameter expansion for the existing credentialed `firecrawl_search` tool.

recommendation.title: Pause keyless search
recommendation.body: Keep Firecrawl search credentialed for now and pause or close this provider addition until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the public provider id and support boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the canonical Firecrawl keyless scrape/fetch boundary and explicitly documented that search remained credentialed pending future sponsorship.
